text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden — a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience in Python and machine learning.

I’ve built weekly store-by-SKU forecasts for 420 SKUs across 31 stores for Marrow & Pine Grocers, scheduled in Airflow and written back to BigQuery. That work reduced WAPE from 31% to 19% and brought spoilage write-offs down 11% in pilot stores.

While my background is in ML, I’m comfortable working with structured assets and adapting existing systems carefully. I can help convert your PDF/AI desktop design into responsive HTML5/CSS for mobile, reuse your current HTML where possible, and create styling where needed while keeping the site consistent.

I’m available to focus on deadlines and deliver clean, maintainable work.

Do you already have the 5 page HTML structure in place, or should I build the responsive pages from the provided assets?
